fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-04-17, Buvaneswari Sri was stopped on a stretch near Vetri Layout Industrial Area by a few persons and a purse was taken. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-04-17 around 19:05 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Anitha Raj (9000000399) on behalf of Buvaneswari Sri, whose contact number is given as 9000000294. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Ganesh Shankar, using the number 9000000155. A motorcycle bearing the number TN-38-ZZ-1005 was seen leaving the area. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a vehicle observation. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00377, as the mobile number 9000000155 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects reportedly followed the victim before stopping the vehicle. A motorcycle was reportedly used to leave the area.
